title: Strong diffeomorphic approximation of three-dimensional Sobolev homeomorphisms up to exponent two
exact_target: For arbitrary bounded connected open domains $Omega,Lambda\subset R^3$, every $1\leq p\leq 2$ and every $W^{1,p}$ homeomorphism f:Omega$\to$Lambda, do smooth $W^{1,p}$ diffeomorphisms $f_j$ between the same domains exist with $integral_Omega(|f_j-f|^p+|Df_j-Df|^p)\to 0$? No inverse Sobolev estimate or quasiconformal bound is requested.
